IRS Direct File is CANCELLED for the 2026 filing season. IRS product manager Cindy Noe informed state revenue departments by email on 2025-11-03 that 'IRS Direct File will not be available in Filing Season 2026. No launch date has been set for the future.' Treasury cited low participation and high cost ($41M to operate for tax year 2024, at least $138 per return). The 2025 season handled 296,531 returns, roughly 0.19% of ~160M US individual e-filed returns. OBBBA Section 70607 directs Treasury to study public-private partnership replacement models. NET: the policy vector moved in Intuit's FAVOUR across the drawdown window. FY2026 was therefore Intuit's first tax season with no IRS Direct File in market -- this follows directly from the cancellation notice above; the season-level characterisation is the runner's inference from that primary cancellation, not a separately sourced company statement.
